rule.statement: A tenant must expressly attorn to the new landlord and continue to pay rent to the transferee from the day of the receipt of the notice of the new transfer, if they want to keep the contract of tenancy.
rule.supporting_quote: The tenant has to expressly attorn to the new landlord and continue to pay the rent to the transferee from the day of the receipt of the notice of the new transfer, if he wants to keep the contract of tenancy.
